title: Why it's not possible to synchronize turn signals (but also absolutely is)
summary: Technology Connections explains why car turn signals appear to drift out of sync at stoplights and how thermal and other flasher designs work. It also covers how synchronization could be achieved.
why: Referenced as a typical example of the channel's hacker-eye view of everyday technology, and for its flasher explanation.

quote.text: The TC channel is definitely a hacker's eye view in to all the technologies that we take for granted every day.
